caseName: Lindsey v. Colorado ex rel. Rush
caseNameFull: Ben B. Lindsey v. People of the State of Colorado at the Relation of John A. Rush, District Attorney, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Colorado.
attorneys: Mr. Edward P. Costigan, with whom Mr. Horace N. Hawkins was on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. Victor E. Keyes, for defendant in error, submitted. Mr. William R. Ramsey was also on the brief.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
